note: Every deterministic interlock, where it lives, and the exact source text that implements it. tests/test_firmware_safety.py fails if any source check stops matching. Source inspection is not bench verification: every gate's bench evidence is NOT MEASURED until an accepted inert session shows it.

gates.behavior: Leaving SAFE requires the switch; releasing it from any other state aborts to SAFE.
Launcher enters READY only after the rocket reports READY within 8 s; otherwise it aborts.
READY aborts if rocket telemetry stops for 2 s.

gates.gate: Dashboard launch enabled as the wartime remote-fire path with authentication
gates.behavior: UDP launch is enabled (MIL-DEV-004) but must be authenticated (HMAC + sequence number, AUTH wrapper) or use the classic inert-bench path, and a plain unauthenticated remote fire without a recent physical hold or OVERRIDE is rejected.

gates.gate: Dashboard launch requires READY plus fire discipline
gates.behavior: UDP launch is accepted only in READY and only with a recent 1 s physical fire-button hold or a valid two-key OVERRIDE; otherwise rejected with launch_needs_fire_hold_or_override.
Commands are ignored unless they come from the address that sent the shared-token HELLO.
The launch button must be held for 1 s with the switch still armed.

gates.gate: Rocket ARM requires IDLE and a healthy IMU
gates.behavior: ARM is refused (and now reported) otherwise.

gates.gate: Rocket IGNITE requires ARMED and a healthy IMU
gates.behavior: IGNITE is refused (and now reported) otherwise.

gates.gate: Rocket IGNITE requires the deploy flag
gates.behavior: IGNITE is refused unless the deploy timer has fired; see discrepancy D-017 for the ordering question.

gates.gate: Deploy trigger requires a non-IDLE state and sustained launch acceleration
gates.behavior: Handling an unarmed rocket cannot fire the deploy output, and a single bump cannot either: the deploy output fires only after the x-axis acceleration holds above the threshold continuously for the sustain time (MIL-DEV-010).
IGNITE_FORCE exists only when BENCH_MODE is defined; the committed build does not define it.
Rocket refusals travel over UART as CMD_REJECT lines; the launcher forwards them and its own ABORT reasons to the dashboard CSV.
PID values outside 0-10 or malformed are rejected on both boards.

gates.gate: Weapons commands are HMAC-authenticated with replay protection
gates.behavior: AUTH-wrapped commands carry an HMAC-SHA256 over sequence number, operator, and payload; monotonic sequence numbers with a sliding replay window block captured-command replay (Phase 5).
The OVERRIDE enabler must be signed by BOTH operator keys (two digital arms) and is valid for 60 s; a dashboard launch without a physical fire hold is rejected otherwise.
Downlink packets are authenticated-encrypted (AES-128-CCM, mbedtls); a crypto failure degrades to plain telemetry, never to silence (Phase 5).

gates.gate: Fuze S&A requires all three arming events
gates.behavior: The fuze arms only on launch acceleration AND canard-deployment confirmation AND the flight-time gate; it functions only on a real impact deceleration (Phase 2).

gates.gate: AUTONOMOUS engagement is an explicit pre-launch selection
gates.behavior: MODE,AUTO (fire-and-forget) is accepted only in IDLE/ARMED as an explicit operator action; MITL is the default (Phase 3).
